typical.destination_writer_status: 256B/cycle sink assumed by endpoint bus; real HBM writer throughput and ack binding required before credit
typical.descriptor_contract: current DS compiler FP32 n512 ->2048B row /32flits; packed288B read/decode not implemented or credited
typical.staging_required_protection: external existing protected SU/VM store; no unprotected new SRAM
typical.mux_cost: existing endpoint single bypass inject, four independent delivery address pipelines
typical.demux_cost: recipient rank guard; four independently registered sink lanes
typical.fanout: one registered run descriptor per delivery lane
typical.routing_basis: separate input/output faces: each needs <=2196 tracks, versus6250 per300um layer; estimate, actual boundary check owed
typical.pipeline_address_arithmetic: rank*pf then local /9,%9 or shift, then slot*G+rank; each boundary registered
typical.chunk_staging_contract: load_v/load_row/load_rows ->load_r only after protected inject store fully staged
typical.latency_composition: stage owned flits + one TU flight per <=512flit complete-row epoch + delivery floor +12 control/drain/pin edges per epoch; overlap not credited
typical.numerical_order: no arithmetic; rank-major wire stream maps to slot-major j*G+r
typical.qualification: analytic only; exact endpoint full shape, record/HBM binding and physical closure required
